SELECT TRIM(o.ORGNZT_ID) AS "orgnztId", o.ORGNZT_NM AS "buseoNm", NVL(o.ORGNZT_DC, o.ORGNZT_NM) AS "fullNm", CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(o.ORGNZT_ID, '^ORG_[0-9]{16}$') THEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(o.ORGNZT_ID, 5)) END AS "buseoNo" FROM COMTNORGNZTINFO o
WHERE UPPER(o.ORGNZT_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
ORDER BY o.ORGNZT_NM
